title: SautiCivic Bridge
tagline: Voice-first civic grievance & legal-aid intake for code-switched Nigerian speech
problem: Citizens describe infrastructure and legal problems in Nigerian Pidgin mixed with English, Yoruba, Hausa or Igbo. Global speech models mis-hear these complaints, and a single wrong word can flip the meaning of a case.
approach: Led architecture and benchmark research for a system that turns code-switched speech into structured municipal tickets and legal-aid intake briefs. A two-tier risk and abstention gate checks confidence, entity completeness, ambiguity and safety before anything happens downstream.
results: Benchmarked four production ASR architectures across 120 recordings and surfaced systematic "don" to "don't" polarity inversions that WER hides
0/30 artifact-corruption failures and 10/10 adversarial harm-avoidance cases
Production stack with PostgreSQL audit logging, 71 automated tests, consent and pseudonymisation safeguards

title: Naija Smart Agent
tagline: Dual-agent recommender & review simulator in Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo
badges: DSN x BCT LLM Agent Challenge
problem: Recommend the right products to Nigerian shoppers from a 112k-item catalogue and simulate realistic reviews, with cultural and multilingual context, not generic Western defaults.
approach: A containerised dual-agent system: FAISS semantic retrieval blended with Bayesian popularity, LLM reranking, and RAG-conditioned review generation. An active-passive failover layer across Gemini and Groq tracks latency, rate limits and provider health with automatic key rotation.
results: Retrieval ablations lifted NDCG@10 from 0.0808 to 0.4210, with Hit@10 0.66 on a 50/50 blend
Review simulation hit BERTScore 0.8447 and RMSE 0.7071
Nigerian-mode prompting improved ROUGE-1 and trait consistency

title: LendraAI
tagline: Explainable credit scoring & cash-flow forecasting for African SMEs
problem: African SMEs are locked out of credit because they lack formal financial histories, even though their transaction data tells a clear story.
approach: Timi built the XGBoost credit-scoring model with SHAP explanations and the interactive dashboard. Teammates built the LSTM cash-flow service and the Interswitch API layer.
results: Real-time risk assessment with per-feature SHAP explanations
Instant loan pre-approval and a Groq-powered financial advisor on top of the scores

title: Gitcast
tagline: git diff → published post in under 60 seconds. Privacy-first, on PyPI
problem: Developers ship work every day but rarely write it up. PR descriptions and posts get skipped because context-switching is expensive.
approach: A global hotkey captures the screen plus local git diff and project context. OCR runs on-device, secrets are detected and blocked automatically, captures are encrypted and cleaned up. Multi-provider LLM routing with BYOK generates PR descriptions, X/LinkedIn posts and long-form articles.
results: Published on PyPI and works out of the box
Vision-model fallback when local OCR confidence is low
Sprint Mode synthesises multi-step development sessions into one write-up

title: Nigerian Commodity Volatility Forecasting
tagline: Regime-aware Elastic Net on PCA factors for maize, rice, PMS & diesel
problem: Food and fuel price volatility hits Nigerian households hard, yet forecasts rarely combine domestic and global signals in a reproducible way.
approach: End-to-end pipeline that merges FEWS NET, FRED, NBS and local data, engineers autoregressive features and principal-component factors, and compares Elastic Net with Random Forest. Every run is tracked in MLflow.
results: Realised-volatility forecasts for maize, rice, PMS and diesel
Forms the basis of his B.Sc. thesis
Live macro risk dashboard with a 1-month forward forecast API

title: Autonomous Outreach Engine
tagline: Multi-agent lead discovery, audit, enrichment and pitching
problem: Finding good-fit clients and writing a useful first message is slow, manual work.
approach: A six-stage LangGraph pipeline: prospect discovery, a Playwright technical-audit agent, deliverability-verified enrichment, a value-add pitcher, a bounded negotiation engine with human-in-the-loop override, and Telegram alerts.
results: Bounded state machine keeps negotiation inside safe limits
Human override at every critical step

title: GreenPulseNG
tagline: AI carbon-emission tracking and insights for Nigerian businesses
problem: Nigerian SMEs have no simple way to measure, report and reduce their carbon footprint.
approach: Decoupled FastAPI backend and React frontend with an emissions dashboard, an AI chat that explains the numbers, and generated PDF reports.
results: Real-time emissions dashboard with AI-written insights
One-click PDF sustainability reports

title: AgroPulse NG
tagline: Multi-model food-inflation forecaster on 12 years of Nigerian market data
problem: Fuel and transport shocks ripple into staple food prices, but the relationship is noisy and the historical data is messy.
approach: A cleaning pipeline that fixes historical unit errors with economic heuristics, then a multi-model engine that picks the best algorithm per commodity (ElasticNet, XGBoost, Prophet), served by a Dockerised FastAPI and a terminal-style Streamlit dashboard.
results: R² 0.94 on predictable staples like beans
Fuel-shock simulator to explore future price paths

title: DebtPulse Africa
tagline: AI fiscal debt-risk scoring & forecasting with a USSD citizen-action layer
problem: Africa's debt crisis is hard to see: official fiscal data is fragmented and full of gaps.
approach: Cleaned 27,000+ rows of fiscal data down to 622 reliable records, built risk scores and 2025–2030 projections, and an interactive dashboard that audits data transparency per country.
results: Rescue scores and distress classification for 14 African countries
USSD concept for citizens to direct funds to verified education/climate projects

title: ML4SCI DeepLense
tagline: CNN detection of dark-matter substructure in gravitational-lensing images
problem: Spotting substructured dark-matter halos in strong-lensing images by eye doesn't scale.
approach: A modernised CNN with log-scaled inputs, LeakyReLU for dark-sky regions, BatchNorm and global average pooling, plus a transfer-learning experiment with EfficientNetB0.
results: Robust separation of smooth versus subhalo lensing profiles
Reproducible notebook with automatic data download
